DESIGN A RESTAURANT AT UDUPI Design a restaurant on a flat rectangular site of dimensions 120mx 75m. in Manipal. One of the shorter sides is abutting the road of 20 m width and facing north. There are high rise apartments on the adjacent properties. The positioning of vegetation and neighboring buildings are left to choice of students. The restaurant should cater to maximum of 180 people at a time (refer the table below). So the area requirements of Kitchen and other amenities have to be assumed accordingly. DESIGN BRIEF OF ONE BUNGLOW: Waiting Lobby 150 sq. m Indoor Dining Area 80 Seating Outdoor Dining Area 10^0 persons Pantry Kitchen Storage Toilets & Wash Parking AE 241 Page 1 of 2 DRAWING REQUIREMENTS: Site Plan Scale 1:200 Floor Plans Scale 1:10^0 Sections Scale 1:10^0 Elevations Scale 1:10^0 Views one view Details Conceptual Drawings SITE(not to scale): MARKS ALLOTED: Site Plan 20 Marks Floor Plans for one bungalow 30 Marks Sections 10 Marks Elevations 10 Marks Views 10 Marks Details 10 Marks Conceptual Drawings 10 Marks ••••• AE 241 Page 2 of 2

TWIN HOLIDAY BUNGALOW FOR BROTHERS AT UDUPI Design identical twin holiday bungalows for two brothers. Each brother has a family of 3. The design should create a surrounding, which would enhance and create a mood for a relaxing holiday. Adequate open spaces shall be proposed. Site is 40 × 25 meters. The longer side abuts a 9-meter wide internal access road. An area of dense vegetation surrounds the site. The land is fairly levelled and has significant vegetation. Consider minimum setback of 1.5m on all sides and 2m on the side of the road. DESIGN BRIEF OF ONE BUNGLOW: Entrance porch 30 sq. m Foyer 8 sq. m Living room 26 sq. m Master bedroom with toilet 25 sq. m Child’s bedroom with toilet 20 sq. m Dining 12 sq. m Kitchen 10 sq. m Common toilet 6 sq. m Car garage 20 sq. m AE 231 Page 1 of 2 DRAWING REQUIREMENTS: Site Plan Scale 1:10^0 Floor Plans Scale 1:50 Sections Scale 1:50 Elevations Scale 1:50 Views 2 views Details Conceptual Drawings MARKS ALLOTED: Site Plan 10 Marks Floor Plans for one bungalow 30 Marks Sections 15 Marks Elevations 15 Marks Views 10 Marks Details 10 Marks Conceptual Drawings 10 Marks ••••• AE 231 Page 2 of 2
